description: This file contains the server-side code for the login page of an online examination system, handling user authentication for students and teachers (including an admin shortcut).

classes.name: LoginPage
classes.description: Partial class representing the code-behind for the login web page, handling page load, user login, and signup redirection.

methods.name: Page_Load
methods.description: Event handler invoked when the page loads; currently does nothing.

methods.name: signupB
methods.description: Redirects the user to the sign-up page.

methods.name: loginButton_Click
methods.description: Handles the login process; authenticates user based on selected account type (Student or Teacher/Admin) and navigates to respective pages.
